study type: Quasi-experimental study with a non-equivalent control group design, employing pre-test and post-test assessments.
outcome: Maternal self-efficacy in caring for babies
cohort: The study included 44 post-CS mothers from Bogor City Hospital, Indonesia, with 22 in an intervention group and 22 in a control group.
finding: The postpartum education and mentoring model significantly increased maternal self-efficacy in post-CS mothers.
